metadata.topic: Optics — Snell's Law: Refraction Angle in Glass and Critical Angle for Glass-Air
metadata.note: Figure 7: triangular glass prism. Ray strikes face XY at S; angle between ray and face XY = 55°, so angle of incidence = 90° − 55° = 35°. Refractive index n = 1.5. Q4d(i): find refraction angle in glass. Q4d(iii) (1m, identify c in diagram) is not auto-gradeable — excluded.

question.name: CSEC Phy Jan 2023 Q4d(i/ii) — Refraction in Glass Prism and Critical Angle
question.text:
A ray of red light strikes the face XY of a glass prism at point S (Figure 7). The angle between the incident ray and the face XY is 55°. The refractive index of the glass for red light is n = 1.5.

Part (d)(i): Calculate the angle of refraction in the glass at S. (3 marks)

Part (d)(ii): Calculate the critical angle, c, for glass to air. (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Q4d(i) — Angle of refraction:
The angle of incidence = 90° − 55° = 35° (angle measured from the normal, not the surface)
Snell's Law: n₁ sin(θ₁) = n₂ sin(θ₂)
1.0 × sin(35°) = 1.5 × sin(θ₂)
sin(θ₂) = 0.5736 / 1.5 = 0.3824
θ₂ = arcsin(0.3824) = 22.5°

Q4d(ii) — Critical angle:
At the critical angle, the refracted ray travels along the glass-air boundary (θ_refracted = 90°).
sin(c) = 1/n = 1/1.5 = 0.6667
c = arcsin(0.6667) = 41.8°

steps.label:
Given: Angle between ray and face XY = 55°  |  n = 1.5 (glass)
Key step: Angle of incidence at S = 90° − 55° = 35° (angle is measured from the normal, not the surface)
Snell's Law: n₁ sin(θ₁) = n₂ sin(θ₂)  |  Critical angle: sin(c) = 1/n (when n₁ = glass, n₂ = air)
Q4d(i) — Calculate the angle of refraction in the glass at S. (3 marks)
Q4d(ii) — Calculate the critical angle c for glass to air. (3 marks)

fields.label: Angle of incidence θ₁ at S = _____ °
fields.diagnostic_hint: θ₁ = 90° − 55° = 35° (the 55° is measured from the face, so the angle from the normal = 90° − 55°)

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: The angle of incidence is measured from the NORMAL (a line perpendicular to the surface). Since the ray makes 55° with the face itself, the angle from the normal = 90° − 55° = 35°.

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: θ₂ = arcsin(0.3824) ≈ 22.5°. Use the inverse sine (sin⁻¹) function on your calculator.

error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: At the critical angle: n₁ × sin(c) = n₂ × sin(90°) = 1 × 1. So sin(c) = n₂/n₁ = 1/1.5 = 0.6667 (for glass-to-air, n₁ = 1.5, n₂ = 1.0).

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: c = arcsin(1/1.5) = arcsin(0.6667) ≈ 41.8°. Use sin⁻¹ on your calculator.
